reproduce: Put the 16 benchmark PNGs in frontend/tools/compress-image/tests/bench-images/ (user-supplied, gitignored).
Serve the frontend with Vite (npm run dev) and open /tools/compress-image/tests/benchmark.html?commit=<hash>.
This run used headless Chrome for Testing 153 from the local Playwright cache, driven over the DevTools protocol, so frames were never throttled. WebKit timings will differ.
meta.inputSet: 16 RGBA PNG card designs, 600x388 to 2440x1530 (max 3.7 MP). No JPEG, WebP or 12+ MP images, so JPEG/WebP and large-image targets are not covered by this baseline.
meta.knownFailure: virtual-serentaun.png (the only input with an iCCP chunk) fails in every scenario: "PNG metadata changed during lossless optimization".

repeatCheck.note: Re-run alone to rule out CPU overlap with another tab during the first seconds of the main run. Sizes identical; wall time within 5%; max stall varies run to run.
